Tooltip: Process for navigates to specified page in confins R3 and verifies that the target page has been loaded successfully.

Arguments.Name: UrlPage
Arguments.Tooltip: URL page to navigate in confins R3.

Arguments.Name: PageHeaderName
Arguments.Tooltip: The header name in page confins R3 to identify is successfully to navigate or not.

Arguments.Name: MaxRetryNavigationPage
Arguments.Tooltip: Maximum number of retries process navigation page in confins R3. The default value is 3.

Arguments.Name: IntervalRetryNavigationPage
Arguments.Tooltip: Interval in seconds to retries process navigation page in confins R3. The default value is 10 seconds.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutNavigationPage
Arguments.Tooltip: Timeout in seconds to check element success navigation page in confins R3. The default value is 30 seconds.
